{{- /* Site-wide footer, injected via Hextra's custom footer hook. Renders one compact row: copyright left, project links right (wrapping on narrow viewports). Hextra's own copyright section is disabled in hugo.yaml (params.footer.displayCopyright: false) because its fixed py-12 block adds a tall empty band; the copyright string still comes from i18n ("copyright"). PLACEHOLDER copy — refine at launch. Links read from site params where possible. On docs pages only, a version stamp line renders above that row. It reads the "joe" site data file, which is GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.sh --seed-from at the moment the committed docs/public copy is refreshed from a joe checkout — so the stamp always describes the copy actually being rendered. No version string is hardcoded here or anywhere else in the tree; if the stamp is missing the line simply does not render. Site data goes through Hextra's hugo-compat helper: Hugo v0.156.0 deprecated site.Data in favor of hugo.Data, and the helper picks the right one for the running version (hugo.yaml declares min 0.146.0). */ -}} {{- $stamp := (partial "utils/hugo-compat/site-data.html").joe -}} {{- if and $stamp $stamp.version $stamp.commit_short (eq .context.Section "docs") -}} {{- $version := $stamp.version -}} {{- /* Untagged joe stamps the literal "pre-release"; parenthesize it so the line reads naturally either way: Documentation for Joe (pre-release), synced from commit abc1234 Documentation for Joe v0.1.0, synced from commit abc1234 */ -}} {{- if eq $version "pre-release" }}{{ $version = printf "(%s)" $version }}{{ end -}}
Documentation for Joe {{ $version }}, synced from commit {{ $stamp.commit_short }}.
{{- end -}}
{{ (T "copyright") | markdownify }}
